cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I agreed to watch your dog today. I've put his bowl away like you did, so we're finishing up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I put it away before his medicine, not at bedtime. My train won't get in until after midnight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, clearing for the next stage. Today still ends at midnight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for a taxi from the station. It'll only leave you with him for twenty minutes tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the taxi to collect him before midnight instead. I agreed to today; you can pay for tomorrow's passenger.
